suspects.description: Watcom shadow-pointer walk — `pCVar4` self-updates via the address of a constant index into itself plus a subfield path, where `N*sizeof(*pCVar4) + offsetof(subfield)` equals the real array stride. Replace `pCVar4->some_field[0]` (or the zero-index access) reads with direct indexing on the original pointer; drop the shadow init and self-update.
